notes.title: Update 2.2 is now available!
notes.content:
[h2]Large update 2.2 is now available for Bus World, featuring a huge chunk of fixes:[/h2]

- Fixed mistakes and inaccuracies in description of some scenarios
- The animation of the passenger in sneakers was corrected
- For better immersion, at the end of all scenarios with emergency situations, the message “Scenario completed successfully” is now displayed, instead of “You have collected enough money”
- Fixed a bug which caused the message "You are trying to accelerate in neutral gear..." to appear when it shouldn't.
- Fixed various bugs with traffic and its distance at traffic lights, as well as with the traffic lights themselves
- Fixed bugs which caused passengers to immediately cross the road after getting off the bus
- Fixed a bug with the engine flood sensor
- Fixed a bug with the clock blinking in the bus cabin
- Fixed a visual bug with leaf particles in Chernobyl
- The bar for points for silver and gold in the “Rockfall” scenario has been raised
- Fixed minor bugs in the layout of the information tablet in the cockpit
- A message informing the player that the bus is full was added at bus stops
- Passenger animation speed has been fixed
- The road material near the Duga Radar Station has been corrected, sand was incorrectly specified there
- Fixed textures of the ground in the forest
- Corrected models of some bushes in Pripyat
- The combined “Brick” and “Give Way” sign near the bus station in Pripyat has been corrected. "Brick" has been removed
- The gap between the “Torch” stop and the ground surface has been removed
- Fixed the problem with the cursor disappearing when exiting the menu from a cutscene
- The siren sound in the cutscene of "Bus haul" scenario has been fixed. If the sound is turned off in the settings, the siren is no longer heard
- Fixed a bug with the movement of athletes in the “Marathon” scenario
- Fixed a bug related to the cameraman in the "Speed" scenario
- Fixed a bug due to which pedestrians in Southern China walked together in large groups
- Fixed bugs related to the tsunami in Southern China
- Adjusted appearance of the HB-235 bus in the garage
- Fixed a bug with the language selection scrollbar in the options menu
- Fixed bugs with passengers getting stuck at some bus stops
- Improved visibility of parking lights of a police minibus in Pripyat
- Headlights no longer pass through fences
- Visual display of fan operation in the bus cabin has been corrected
- Iceland scenarios have been added to the “Master” achievement (pass all scenarios for gold)
- Corrected display of mobile phones for drivers in random accident events in China
- The color of the ocean in Iceland in the late evening has been corrected, now it corresponds to the time of day
- In many places of Chernobyl, excess grass has been removed from roads and gas stations
- The altitude and speed of the aircraft in the free mode of Iceland has been reduced

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36189081/f0ef342b68c315010d1c8226ed81320ed58c185f.png[/img]

You can also discuss the update on our Discord server.
Here's the link: http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap

Also, make sure to follow our page on X (ex. Twitter): https://twitter.com/kishmishstudio

notes.title: A large update with lots of changes is available
notes.content:
[h2]We released a large update for Bus World that includes many changes.[/h2]

- Added an airplane to Iceland map. It flies almost all around the map
- Added geysers in Iceland Free Mode
- Improved interior textures of OSB Mir
- Added a texture for openable part of the window on OSB Vostok
- Adjusted color of protective shields on OSB Vostok
- If you're standing exactly above the geyser, the impulse will be stronger when it erupts

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36189081/dc38e476fafe127834ea4291c95f3ac1dc772add.jpg[/img]

- Removed passengers that don't look like tourists in "Meeting of tourists" scenario
- Adjusted alarm sound for parked cars in Iceland
- Scenario list is now displayed correctly in 1280x1024 resolution
- Fixed the problem that caused tsunami to not flip the bus upside down. In certain cases, you could even survive the full submersion. Now, you can't
- Fixed abnormally high speed of water texture in Tsunami scenario
- Removed wiper marks at the very beginning of "Bad weather" scenario
- Fixed a bug that caused water droplets to appear wrongly on traffic's windshields in some cases
- Removed the white stripe in rainy night - it looked as if the horizon was glowing
- Fixed the truck model looking like it's covered in water even in sunny weather
- Added a brick sign near a dead end near Duga Radar Station
- Removed grass on the road near ChNPP

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36189081/96cae965187debb312d99d45e8d1589e79200805.jpg[/img]

- Fixed the position of a parked car near ChNPP. It was floating in the air before
- Recovered the appearance of grass: it no longer renders on the road and does not float in the air on slopes
- You can no longer drive into fire in "Fire near Duga" scenario
- Fixed three achievements that could be unlocked in some non-intended circumstances
- Fixed a bug that caused the fine value to overlap the fine cause
- The background of the dashboard went missing when turning on the ignition on KM Dragon. Fixed
- Time for stops sometimes became improperly positioned. Fixed
- ChNPP bus stop wasn't translated into Korean. Fixed
- In some languages, some text on gas stations wasn't displayed. Now it's displayed on every language
- Now you can open the driver's door that is an upgrade for OSB Vostok. You can also open the window on this door
- Removed animation of looking at a non-existent phone for passengers
- Fixed a bug that could sometimes cause bus to burn down in lava even before the lava gets to the bus in "Volcano eruption" scenario
- In "Marathon" scenario, athletes could run through the bus. Removed the ability to drive to them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36189081/12cac4ebaebeb533ee8527f1a867207e1296d294.jpg[/img]

- On one of the crossroads in Chornobyl, the traffic ran into the player who had the main road. Fixed
- In "Volcano eruption", the sky was too bright. Made it darker
- The lava flow in "Volcano eruption" was floating in the air. Now it no longer does that

You can also discuss the release on our Discord server.
Here's the link: http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap

Also, make sure to follow our page on X (ex. Twitter): https://twitter.com/kishmishstudio

notes.title: Patch 1.6.1 is available
notes.content:
Patch 1.6.1 is available on Steam and will be released on other platforms soon.

What’s changed:
- Before this update, if bus stops were very close to each other, you could accidentally drive into one on the opposite side of the road and skip all stops before it. This bug has been fixed.
- Added the new window for game mode selection so that it’s easier to find Free Mode among other scenarios.
- Fixed incorrect color of plants on Chornobyl map.
- Now you can get fined for crashing with the bus that you’re towing as well as with your bus.
- Reduced damage while driving on a tarmac road near Duga so you can drive faster there.
- Added light fog to the Overcast weather.
- Other minor fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36189081/814faec9af0b8482ad3ae58dda944e6aefefd77e.jpg[/img]

*Screenshot by Vandeymer from Steam Community.

notes.title: Update 1.4.4 is available!
notes.content:
Important update 1.4.4 is now available. Here's what we changed:

- Added smoke coming from the exhaust.
- Added automatic calculation of time interval between stops in Free Mode. It's calculated based on the distance between stops.
- Passengers now walk in different directions after leaving the bus.
- Fixed missing needles on OSB-3101's gauges.
- Improved camera logics. Now you won't be able to look inside the buildings and other objects.
- Adjusted lighting in Chornobyl.
- Fixed a problem that caused passengers' mood indicator not to show sometimes.
- Hands of the driver are now correctly positioned the steering wheel.
- Third person camera is now fixed in one position, if mouse steering is enabled. If player holds right mouse button, wheel controls are locked, and camera is unlocked.
- UI now should work better on monitors with aspect ratio of 32:9.

Let's look at what we'd like to add into the game in the next year. This list is still subject to changes (the better are the sales, the more features we'll be able to implement).

- Add one more Soviet bus
- Expand Chornobyl map, add new forest roads and swamps
- New scenarios, including ones on the new territories of Chornobyl map
- TrackIR support
- Physically correct dirt with player's bus leaving the tracks
- Rainy weather and water drops on the windshield
- Something very big and interesting (we're already working on this!). We'll tell more about it soon :)

notes.title: The update is available, featuring fixes for steering wheels and controllers!
notes.content:
We just published another patch for the game. It affects controls, when several controllers are connected at once.

Before, buttons of controllers were read from each controller separately, unlike axles. Because of that, axles’ values could be recognized incorrectly. Now the game can distinguish the axles of the first 4 connected controllers.

But Unity Engine, which the game is built on, can’t guarantee that the controllers will be detected in the exact same order as the previous time. Each new connected controller will be detected as a new one. Probably, we’ll solve this problem a bit later.

You can read more about setting up controllers here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2883063682

notes.title: What has changed during the last two weeks?
notes.content:
We'd like to thank all players who supported us by playing the game! Also, special thank you goes to everyone who wrote a review on Steam. Thanks to your feedback, we understood that you liked the game, which gives us even more motivation to continue working on it and make Bus World better.

Since the initial Early Access release, we've been fixing problems and uploading patches. During the last two weeks we accumulated quite a bit list of fixes and changes:

- Fixed several problems affecting steering wheels.
- Fixed a bug that rarely caused mirrors to render black.
- Fixed a bug that caused "Tornado" sceiario to become unbeatable.
- Fixed navigator in "Red Forest" scenario.
- Fixed a bug that caused navigator to build a route through yet non-existent roads.
- Added display of game version in main menu.
- Fixed collision of traffic cars near Jupiter factory.
- Fixed cars spawning incorrectly in "With the last ounce of strength" scenario.
- Trucks in "Bridge construction" scenario now turn smoother.
- Fixed some visual bugs such as passengers' position inside buses.
- Re-balanced score necessary for Gold medal in "Fire near Duga" scenario.
- Asjusted passengers' dissatiscaction on the wooden bridge in Southern China.
- You can now cancel key assignment using Esc.
- Re-added instruction windows when assigning keys and axles.
- Achievements are now translated into more languages.
- Adjusted some objects on both maps.
- Other fixes and changes.
